previews.caption: The raised gizmo holds a cloth patch while both camera images update. This is an external pin, not evidence that the robot is grasping the cloth.
The Material panel marks density as a rebuild edit and lists areal_density in Pending rebuild. In the tested hand-written Scene, Apply & rebuild directs the user back to the source script.
The Cameras panel displays front and overhead images from the tiled renderer. These are declared camera views, distinct from a screenshot of the interactive browser viewport.
